## Description {#details}

<p>A <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/xray/trace">Trace</a> object represents the records that have been loaded from XRay log files generated by instrumented binaries.</p>


<p>We encapsulate the logic of reading the traces in factory functions that populate the <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/xray/trace">Trace</a> object appropriately.</p>


<p><a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/xray/trace">Trace</a> objects provide an accessor to an <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/structs/llvm/xray/xrayfileheader">XRayFileHeader</a> which says more about details of the file from which the XRay trace was loaded from.</p>


<p>Usage:</p>


<p>if (auto TraceOrErr = loadTraceFile("xray-log.something.xray")) { auto&amp; T = *TraceOrErr; // T.getFileHeader() will provide information from the trace header. for (const <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/structs/llvm/xray/xrayrecord">XRayRecord</a> &amp;R : T) { // ... do something with R here. } } else { // Handle the error here. }</p>


<p>Definition at line 46 of file <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/include/include/llvm/include/llvm/xray/trace-h">Trace.h</a>.</p>
